prompts.label: Review an application
prompts.text:
Check this fictional permit application against my checklist. Make a table showing what is included, missing or unclear. Refer to the checklist item and section labels so I can check each point. Ask questions that would help fill in the missing details. Missing information is not an automatic failure. Do not approve, deny, score, rank or recommend a permit decision.

Checklist item 1: Include a project budget.
Checklist item 2: Identify an implementation owner.
Checklist item 3: Provide a delivery schedule.
Section 1: The Facilities team is the implementation owner.
Section 2: Work starts April 1, 2027 and completes June 30, 2027.
Section 3: Work starts April 1, 2027 and completes July 31, 2027.

No budget or statement identifying the current schedule is supplied. Point out the disagreement without choosing a date. Do not take any external action.

prompts.label: Summarize case notes
prompts.text:
Read these fictional case notes. Summarize what they say, show where statements disagree or information is missing, and suggest follow-up questions. Refer to the note labels so I can check your answer. Do not choose a date without support or invent rules. Do not decide eligibility or update any system.

Note 1: Intake completed August 15, 2026; follow-up August 22, 2026.
Note 2: Intake completed August 17, 2026; follow-up August 22, 2026.
Note 3: Proof of address is still outstanding. No supporting document is supplied.

No policy text is supplied. Tell me what a person needs to check next.

prompts.label: Compare a proposal (preview)
prompts.text:
Compare this fictional proposal with my checklist. Make a table with one row per checklist item. Show what is described, what is missing, and where the documents disagree. Quote or refer to the checklist item and document labels so I can check each point. Do not treat a brochure claim as a tested product feature. Ask what else is needed; do not choose a vendor or recommend an award.

Checklist item 1: Support CSV export of service-request records.
Checklist item 2: Retain audit records for seven years.
Checklist item 3: Support single sign-on with documented supported protocols.
Product sheet: The sample product exports service-request records as CSV and retains audit records for seven years.
Admin guide: The sample administrator guide says audit records are deleted after thirty days.
Brochure: The sample brochure says the product is enterprise-ready.

No other documentation or test results are supplied. Do not assume single sign-on is supported. Missing information does not automatically mean a requirement is failed. Do not take any external action.
